result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and sidewalks but lacks pedestrian refuge islands, creating a long, unprotected crossing distance across multiple lanes. The commercial environment and wide roadway geometry suggest a high-speed traffic flow that prioritizes vehicle throughput over pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: Wide lanes and open geometry at a large intersection encourage higher vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time and reduce exposure.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane arterial roadway with a car-centric design that prioritizes vehicle throughput. While sidewalks and basic crosswalk markings are present, the lack of pedestrian refuge islands and the long crossing distances across multiple lanes create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island, maximizing exposure to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Main intersection crossing in the center-right background.

hazards.name: High-Speed Road Geometry
hazards.description: Wide travel lanes and large turning radii at the slip lane encourage high vehicle speeds through the pedestrian environment.
hazards.location_in_image: Main roadway and the slip lane on the left foreground.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Visible cracking and wear on the roadway surface can create tripping hazards or affect vehicle braking performance.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace standard transverse markings with continental or ladder-style markings to increase visibility to approaching drivers.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including a marked crosswalk and sidewalks, but lacks robust protection. The wide roadway and absence of visible pedestrian signals or refuge islands create a high-exposure environment for those crossing.

hazards.name: High Exposure Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic with no median refuge.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection.

interventions.title: Install Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide multi-lane roadway with marked continental crosswalks and signalized control in a commercial setting. Pedestrians face a long crossing distance across at least five lanes of traffic without a median refuge, significantly increasing exposure to vehicular traffic.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross five or more lanes of traffic in a single stage, increasing exposure time to vehicles.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Refuge
hazards.description: The absence of a median refuge island leaves pedestrians vulnerable if they cannot complete the crossing in one signal cycle.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large tree on the corner may partially obscure pedestrians from the view of drivers making right-hand turns.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.
